lessonTitle: 74. The altitudes of a triangle meet at one point
lessonTitleEnglish: The altitudes of a triangle meet at one point
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 8 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Theorem: the altitudes of a triangle (or their extensions) meet at one point, the orthocentre.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem: the altitudes of a triangle (or their extensions) meet at one point, the orthocentre.

stages.headline: The orthocentre is inside an acute triangle, at the right-angle vertex of a right triangle, and outside an obtuse one.
stages.headlineEnglish: The orthocentre is inside an acute triangle, at the right-angle vertex of a right triangle, and outside an obtuse one.

stages.headline: Proof idea: draw lines through the vertices parallel to the opposite sides; the big triangle's perpendicular bisectors are the original altitudes.
stages.headlineEnglish: Proof idea: draw lines through the vertices parallel to the opposite sides; the big triangle's perpendicular bisectors are the original altitudes.

stages.headline: Where do the altitudes of a right triangle meet?
stages.headlineEnglish: Where do the altitudes of a right triangle meet?

choices: at the midpoint of the hypotenuse
optionsQuiz.feedbackIncorrect: 🤔 Not quite. The correct answer is {correctText}.
